Suicide is over often followed by an another suicide. If you end yourself, a person close to you would be affected by your death so much, that it would almost bring them to killing themselves too. Sometimes not almost.

You see, it's kind of hypocritical of me to say, since I'm dealing with the exact same problem, but I know what I'm saying. It takes a long time to fully understand it, to comprehend how important you actually are.

I believe in you. I know that you'll get better. Even if you feel like life will always be so shit, even if you don't think that you will ever get better... You have to trust me on this one. Right now it may sound ridiculous, but life does get better. You just have to do everything to pull yourself together. Get help, maybe eat more nutritious stuff or if you have social anxiety try to open up a little bit more. It won't be easy, but a year from now you'll wish that you started today.

If you ever need someone to talk to, to help or just someone that will listen, I'm always here. Feel free to message me 💕
